name: Lightweight Chromium Workspace
postStartCommand: docker start chromium 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name=chromium -e PUID=1000 -e PGID=1000 -e TZ=Etc/UTC -e CHROME_CLI='https://discord.com/app https://www.instagram.com https://www.tiktok.com' -p 3000:3000 -p 3001:3001 -v "$HOME/.chromium-data:/config" --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --shm-size='2gb' --restart unless-stopped lscr.io/linuxserver/chromium:latest
